message.content: Research-only (no edits) in a React+Vite frontend at C:\Users\jotac\OneDrive\Documents\DEV\deliveryhub_white_label and NestJS backend at C:\Users\jotac\OneDrive\Documents\DEV\serer_delivery. I'm building a new feature: a plan-gated custom favicon per store (white-label restaurant). When enabled, a store's own `logo_url` replaces the platform's default favicon (``) in the browser tab — both when the store is accessed via its own custom domain AND when accessed via the platform's own `/r/:slug` route (e.g. deliveryhub.teusite.top/r/sereiadomar). I already know: - `src/pages/home-router/index.jsx` (lines ~14-25) detects custom-domain access via `getCardapioPorDominio(window.location.hostname)` and renders `` when a store matches that hostname. - The actual store page component is `restaurante-catalogo` (`src/pages/restaurante-catalogo/index.jsx`), which uses `restaurante.logo_url` for an `` tag around line 443. - Backend: `GET /r/by-domain/:host` and `GET /r/:slug` (both in `catalogo.controller.ts`) already return `logo_url` in their response. - Plan flags exist as `inclui_delivery`/`inclui_salao`/`inclui_gdoor` on the `planos` table (DTOs in `criar-plano.dto.ts`/`atualizar-plano.dto.ts`), exposed to the frontend as `modulo_delivery`/`modulo_salao`/`modulo_gdoor` (via `planos.service.ts` around lines 267-269). Please find and report: 1. Find the React Router route definition (probably in `src/Routes.jsx`) for accessing a store via `/r/:slug` — which component renders there? Is it the SAME `restaurante-catalogo` component as the custom-domain path, or a different one? Report the exact route path pattern and component. 2. Does `restaurante-catalogo/index.jsx` (or whatever component handles `/r/:slug`) fetch its own store data independently (e.g. via a slug from `useParams()`), or does it always rely on `dadosPreCarregados` passed as a prop from `home-router`? If it fetches independently for the `/r/:slug` case, find that fetch call and confirm whether the response includes plan-flag data (something like `modulo_delivery`) that I could extend with a new flag. 3. Find the "Aparência" (Appearance) panel in the restaurant owner's dashboard — likely `src/pages/restaurante-aparencia/` or similar, search for "Aparência" or "aparencia" in `src/pages/`. Report the file path and how it's structured (does it already show any plan-gated "recurso pago, faça upgrade" style notices for other paid features, so I can mirror that exact UI pattern? Search for "upgrade" or "plano" mentions within that file). 4. Confirm the exact current full list of plan flags exposed to frontend as `modulo_X` (from `restaurante.service.ts` or `planos.service.ts`, wherever `moduloDelivery`/`moduloSalao`/`moduloGdoor` get attached to the "minha empresa" response used by `useModulosEmpresa()` hook) — I want to add a new one following the exact same naming/wiring convention. Report the file + line where these modulo_X fields get attached to that response object. 5. Is there an existing favicon-related utility/hook anywhere already (e.g. `useFavicon`) even if not currently wired up anywhere? Search broadly one more time just to be sure nothing was missed. Report concisely (under 500 words), file paths + line numbers + short snippets. Pure fact-finding for planning purposes.

content.text:
Nav items simply get filtered out (not shown at all) rather than shown-disabled-with-upgrade-message — no inline "faça upgrade" banner pattern exists in `restaurante-aparencia` or `restaurante-salao`. The only actual "upgrade" UI text lives in the dedicated plan-comparison page `restaurante-plano/index.jsx` (lines 157, 267, 284), not as a reusable inline gating component.

## Findings

**1. Route for `/r/:slug`** — `src/Routes.jsx:110`:
```jsx
<Route path="/r/:slug" element={<RestauranteCatalogo />} />
```
Same component (`restaurante-catalogo`) as the custom-domain path rendered by `home-router`. Confirmed identical component, just reached two different ways.

**2. Data fetching in `restaurante-catalogo/index.jsx`** — it does NOT always rely on `dadosPreCarregados`. It reads `slug` via `useParams()` (import at line 2) and, when there's no preloaded data, calls `getCardapioPorSlug(slug)` (`src/services/restauranteService.js:293-302`), which hits `GET /api/r/:slug`. Backend handler is `catalogo.controller.ts:330-346` (`cardapio()`), and `by-domain` variant at lines 311-328. **Important:** both selects only include `modulo_delivery`, not `modulo_salao`/`modulo_gdoor`:
```
.select('id, name, address, logo_url, business_hours, slug, aparencia, frete_motoboy, modulo_delivery, pagamento_manual, payment_config')
```
(lines 320 and 338, identical). So if you add a new gating flag (e.g. `modulo_favicon`), you must explicitly add it to this select list in both the `by-domain/:host` and `:slug` handlers — it won't be there by default.

**3. Aparência panel** — `src/pages/restaurante-aparencia/index.jsx`. Fetches via `getAparencia()` + `getMinhaEmpresa()` (Promise.all, line 91), saves via `updateAparencia`/`updateEmpresa`. **No existing plan-gated "upgrade" banner pattern inside this file** — no `Lock`/`upgrade`/`plano` gating text found. Plan-gating elsewhere in the app is done by simply hiding nav links (`RestauranteHeader.jsx:66,86` — `getRestauranteNavLinks(moduloDelivery, moduloSalao, ...)` filters items out), not by showing a disabled control with an upsell message. The only actual "Upgrade" UI text is in the dedicated `src/pages/restaurante-plano/index.jsx` (lines 157 "Plano atual", 267, 284 "Upgrade de plano") — a full comparison page, not an inline component you can drop into Aparência.

**4. Full `modulo_X` list** — `src/hooks/useModulosEmpresa.js:5-14`:
```js
moduloDelivery: !!data?.empresa?.modulo_delivery,
moduloSalao: !!data?.empresa?.modulo_salao,
moduloGdoor: !!data?.empresa?.modulo_gdoor,
autoAtendimentoHabilitado: !!data?.empresa?.auto_atendimento_habilitado,
tipoRestaurante: !!data?.empresa?.tipo_restaurante,
```
Backend wiring where plan `inclui_X` → `modulo_X` happens: `serer_delivery/src/planos/planos.service.ts:267-269`:
```
modulo_delivery: plano.inclui_delivery,
modulo_salao: plano.inclui_salao,
modulo_gdoor: plano.inclui_gdoor,
```
Also stored/selected directly on the `restaurants` table itself (not just derived from plan) in `serer_delivery/src/restaurante/restaurante.service.ts:60` and `empresas.service.ts` (lines 19, 32, 67-69, 80-82, 99-101, 119-121) — the empresas admin panel (`/admin/empresas`) can independently override these per-store flags. Any new flag needs matching entries in: `criar-plano.dto.ts`/`atualizar-plano.dto.ts` (backend DTO), `planos.service.ts` mapping, `restaurante.service.ts` select, `empresas.controller.ts`/`empresas.service.ts` (admin override), `catalogo.controller.ts` selects (for public `/r/` responses), and `useModulosEmpresa.js` (frontend hook).

**5. No favicon utility exists.** Searched both repos case-insensitively for "favicon" — only hits are the static `index.html:13` (`<link rel="icon" href="/favicon.ico" />`) and `public/manifest.json`. No `useFavicon` hook, no dynamic favicon-swapping code anywhere in either repo. This is a greenfield addition.
